segments.name: Term Life Insurance
segments.description: Underwrites and sells term life insurance to middle-income clients through its life insurance subsidiaries Primerica Life, NBLIC and Primerica Life Canada.
segments.evidence: The financial results of our Term Life Insurance segment benefit from the stability of a large in-force block of life insurance policies, with a substantial portion of revenues generated from recurring premiums.

segments.name: Investment and Savings Products
products: Mutual Funds and Certain Retirement Plans
segments.description: Distributes mutual funds, annuities, managed investments and retirement plans to clients, earning sales commissions and advisory and administrative service fees.
segments.evidence: The financial results of our Investment and Savings Products segment benefit from clients' long-term investment focus and the expected intergenerational transfer of wealth, which should continue to favorably impact demand for the mutual funds, annuity products and management investments we distribute.

segments.name: Corporate and Other Distributed Products
products: Supplemental Health and Accidental Death & Disability Insurance
segments.description: Distributes mortgage loans, prepaid legal services, identity theft defense, insurance and home automation products from third-party providers, and carries unallocated corporate costs.
segments.evidence: Costs that are not directly charged or allocated to our two primary operating segments are included in the Corporate and Other Distributed Products segment.

revenueModel.text: Clients and policyholders pay premiums, sales commissions and fee-based advisory and administrative charges for the insurance and investment products they buy.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenues in this segment are entirely fee-based, which include sales commissions and investment advisory and administrative service fees.
